programme.title: Hunt For Family Court Killer
programme.desc: Pembunuhan, terorisme, dan pembunuhan berencana diselidiki kembali oleh seorang Kepala Inspektur perempuan yang gigih. Selama 40 tahun, sebuah bab kelam kejahatan yang dilakukan atas nama nilai-nilai keluarga tetap belum terpecahkan. Dengan menggunakan berbagai arsip serta tiga sudut pandang yang saling melengkapi—para korban, kepolisian, dan lembaga peradilan—serial dokumenter ini menggali konteks sosial dan politik pada masa tersebut. Serial yang kuat dan menarik ini mengungkap kasus terorisme dalam negeri pada 1980-an, kekerasan dalam rumah tangga, serta meningkatnya kelompok-kelompok pria konservatif sebagai respons terhadap Family Court yang progresif. Kisah ini mengungkap bab mengejutkan dalam sejarah sosial Australia yang ternyata masih memiliki relevansi yang mengkhawatirkan hingga saat ini.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: Goalkeeping With Petr Cech : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Legendary goalkeeper, Petr Cech, sits down with Will Perry to discuss the role of the goalkeeper in the Premier League and how it has changed over the years. Cech gives his unique insight into the mentality of a goalkeeper and reflects on his career before breaking down and analysing some of the key attributes that make a great goalkeeper. He also selects five iconic Premier League goalkeepers to build his dream keeper for the modern game.

programme.title: Ini Asli Bang Strawberry Apa Paksu?
programme.desc: Pada suatu hari, Rena yang bekerja di kebun strawberry milik ayahnya, dipaksa untuk bertunangan dengan Dimas hingga ia kabur. Saat Rena kabur, tanpa sengaja ia masuk ke mobil milik Bara, seorang anak konglomerat yang tengil dan berbuat seenaknya sendiri. Bara yang sedang mengemudi, kaget ketika mengetahui keberadaan Rena di dalam mobilnya. Bara segera menghentikan mobilnya. Bara menuduh Rena adalah seorang pembegal mobil. Rena tidak terima. Keduanya terlibat percekcokan. Kemudian, Bara yang diminta papanya untuk mendapatkan kebun strawberry milik ayah Rena, terpaksa harus mendekati Rena. Awalnya Bara dan Rena sering cekcok, tapi lama kelamaan Bara mulai menyukai Rena yang baik hati, padahal ia sudah punya tunangan bernama Sheila.

programme.title: Kura Kura Dalam Perahu Pura Pura Punya Pacar Baru
programme.desc: Vanka mengikuti acara kemping dengan teman-temannya di sebuah perbukitan. Saat sedang hiking, tiba-tiba Vanka terpeleset dan masuk jurang. Ia meminta pertolongan, tapi tidak ada yang mendengarnya. Teman-teman Vanka baru menyadari Vanka bilang saat mereka berkumpul dan pemimpin regu menanyakan keberadaan Vanka. programme.title: Hidden Cities Extreme S2, Ep 1
programme.desc: Musim kedua Hidden Cities Extreme menghadirkan petualangan yang lebih berani saat Simon Yin menjelajahi berbagai negara di Asia untuk merasakan langsung tradisi dan kebiasaan yang tidak biasa. Mulai dari berburu tikus di Filipina, menyelam bebas di Indonesia, meminum urine sapi di India, mengikuti balap unta di Mongolia Dalam, hingga berlatih menjadi ninja di Jepang, setiap perjalanan memperlihatkan sisi budaya yang jarang diketahui wisatawan. Dengan berinteraksi langsung bersama masyarakat setempat, serial ini mengungkap kisah-kisah unik dan pengalaman ekstrem yang memperlihatkan keberagaman budaya Asia dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

programme.title: Frasier S7, Ep 12
programme.desc: Frasier Season 7 mengikuti kehidupan Dr. Frasier Crane, seorang psikiater yang bekerja sebagai penyiar radio, saat menghadapi berbagai masalah dalam pekerjaan, keluarga, persahabatan, dan hubungan asmara. Bersama saudaranya Niles, ayahnya Martin, Daphne, dan Roz, Frasier menghadapi berbagai situasi kocak seputar cinta, pernikahan, pekerjaan, konflik keluarga, dan usahanya mengendalikan kehidupan yang semakin rumit.

programme.title: Knight Rider S1, Ep 22
programme.desc: Knight Rider Season 1 mengikuti Michael Knight, mantan polisi yang mendapat identitas baru setelah mengalami luka parah. Bekerja untuk Knight Foundation, Michael menangani berbagai kasus berbahaya bersama K.I.T.T., mobil canggih yang dilengkapi kecerdasan buatan dan hampir tidak dapat dihancurkan. Melalui wawancara eksklusif, rekaman arsip, dan penelusuran investigatif, dokumenter tiga episode ini mengungkap bagaimana berbagai kejanggalan akhirnya membawa pada penemuan bahwa Delimar masih hidup bertahun-tahun kemudian. Kisah ini menyoroti perjuangan keluarga mencari kebenaran di balik salah satu kasus penculikan anak yang paling mengejutkan di Amerika Serikat.

programme.title: MasterChef S16: Keeping Up
programme.desc: Lima koki rumahan terbaik bersaing untuk mendapatkan tempat di babak final dengan mengikuti Chef Gordon Ramsay dan Tiffany Derry saat mereka membuat ulang hidangan andalan mereka secara langsung. Tidak boleh tertinggal, karena hanya tiga koki yang akan melaju ke babak berikutnya.

programme.title: Celebrity Wheel Of... S5, Ep 1
programme.desc: Celebrity Wheel of Fortune menyambut para kontestan selebriti untuk memutar roda paling terkenal di dunia dan memecahkan teka-teki kata untuk kesempatan memenangkan hadiah hingga $1 juta.

programme.title: Entertainment Tonight
programme.desc: Sejak pertama kali diluncurkan, ENTERTAINMENT TONIGHT telah menjadi otoritas terkemuka dalam pemberitaan hiburan terkini. Program ini merupakan majalah berita hiburan terkemuka di dunia yang disiarkan secara nasional.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen S25, Ep 1
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay kembali di Musim 25 “Hell’s Kitchen”, menampilkan para koki yang semuanya berusia di bawah 25 tahun untuk bersaing memperebutkan hadiah utama.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Tim sepak bola terhebat di dunia harus menghadapi tantangan baru, di mana bakat saja tak cukup dan setiap pertandingan penuh kejutan dari lawan.

programme.title: Masha & The Bear
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Rintik Terakhir
programme.desc: Bercerita tentang Karang Samudra Daneswara yang terbangun dari koma dan menemukan dirinya dikendalikan oleh kepribadian baru bernama Arutala. Akibatnya, hubungan Karang dengan kekasihnya, Launa dan keluarganya menjadi rumit.

programme.title: Princess And The Boss
programme.desc: Demi menjadi beauty influencer sukses, keira membuat video kritik untuk lini kosmetik ""beaucity"". Sayangnya, video itu berdampak buruk pada hubungan bisnis ayahnya, sehingga keira harus memperbaikinya.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animation
programme.desc: Mr. Bean laki-laki yang mempunyai sikap sedikit kekanak-kanakan yang berusaha bertahan hidup di kota London dan sangat kompetititf. Dalam series animasi, ia digambarkan lebih beruntung dan kompeten dari versi live actionya.

programme.title: Ikhlas Paling Serius
programme.desc: Drama romantis yang mengikuti Fajar, seorang people pleaser yang menjadi asisten pribadi Farah, CEO perfeksionis. Fajar terjebak dilema saat ditugaskan memata-matai Farah, namun justru jatuh cinta dan terlibat konflik rumit.

programme.title: Negeri 5 Menara
programme.desc: Negeri 5 Menara series bercerita tentang Alif, pemuda minangkabau memiliki cita-cita tinggi. Ia ingin sekolah di ITB & menjadi sosok seperti idolanya, B.J. Habibie. Sayangnya keinginan Alif tidak mendapat respon baik dari ibunya.

programme.title: Sajadah Panjang
programme.desc: Keluarga Andhika merupakan keluarga bahagia yang penuh cinta. Namun bagaimana jika seorang ayah yang selama ini mereka banggakan, ternyata malah menyakiti hati seluruh keluarganya?

programme.title: Montase
programme.desc: Program magazine tentang movie & series review, menghadirkan para cast dan mengkombinasikan game show

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Berkisah tentang 2 bersaudara Andin dan Elsa yang tanpa sengaja mencintai pria yang sama yaitu Nino. Hubungan mereka berdua yang memang tidak pernah baik menjadi semakin buruk setelah Nino menikah dengan Andin.

programme.title: Bunga Di Tepi Jurang
programme.desc: Andini, seorang gadis muda dari desa kecil, memimpikan kehidupan yang lebih layak di kota besar. Namun, langkahnya justru membawanya ke dunia yang keras dan tak terduga, tempat bertahan hidup menuntut pengorbanan.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: Raya, penari klub malam, yang menyamar sebagai saudara kembar identik-nya telah meninggal, Anna. Penyamaran ini bertujuan membongkar rahasia kelam keluarga politisi Ardana yang sangat berkuasa di balik kematian misterius Anna.

programme.title: Kau & Dia
programme.desc: Zara dan Anneth, tumbuh bersahabat dan berjanji saling selalu ada dan melindungi satu sama lain. Kehadiran Naldo membuat persahabatan mereka diuji dengan pilihan cinta remaja.

programme.title: Customs Protection
programme.desc: Program acara realitas yang menampilkan keseharian beberapa petugas bea dan cukai, tidak hanya menyaksikan aksi Bea Cukai Indonesia dalam penggerebekan, tetapi kita juga diajak untuk menyaksikan kejadian yang sesungguhnya terjadi di lapangan.
Di program 86, pemirsa akan diajak bersama melihat keseharian beberapa anggota polisi.

programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Numberblocks

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

programme.title: Tian Tian

programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 24: MASTER JOURNEYS
programme.desc: "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH SALAH SATU SERI TERBARU DALAM FRANCHISE POKEMON YANG MELANJUTKAN PERJALANAN ASH KETCHUM SEBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON. SERI INI MENAMPILKAN PETUALANGAN ASH BERSAMA DENGAN TEMANNYA, PIKACHU, DALAM MENJELAJAHI BERBAGAI WILAYAH POKEMON YANG BERBEDA. MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN BERBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON BARU, MENANTANG GYM LEADERS, DAN MENGHADAPI TIM ROCKET YANG SELALU INGIN MENCURI POKEMON. SALAH SATU FOKUS UTAMA DARI "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH PENJELAJAHAN DUNIA POKEMON YANG LUAS. ASH DAN TEMAN-TEMANNYA BERTUJUAN UNTUK MENGHADIRI WORLD CORONATION SERIES, SEBUAH KOMPETISI BESAR DI MANA MEREKA BERUSAHA UNTUK MENJADI JUARA POKEMON MASTER. DI SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN POKEMON LEGENDARIS, MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN BARU, DAN BELAJAR LEBIH BANYAK TENTANG DUNIA POKEMON. SERI INI JUGA MENGEKSPLORASI DINAMIKA ANTARA ASH, PIKACHU, DAN KARAKTER-KARAKTER LAIN YANG MEREKA TEMUI DALAM PETUALANGAN MEREKA. DENGAN FOKUS PADA PERTUMBUHAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN KEKUATAN TIM, "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" MENYAJIKAN PETUALANGAN YANG SERU DAN PENUH DENGAN KEJUTAN BAGI PARA PENGGEMAR POKEMON.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Keluarga Somat

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Just For Laughs
programme.desc: Sebuah acara komedi bisu Kanada yang dibuat oleh grup Just For Laughs. Acara ini menampilkan orang-orang yang dijebak dalam berbagai situasi aneh oleh para aktor sementara sebuah kamera tersembunyi merekam reaksi mereka.

programme.title: MINIBODS
programme.desc: SELAMAT DATANG DI DUNIA MINIBODS! BERSAMA VERSI KECIL DARI KARAKTER ODDBODS YANG IKONIK, SAKSIKAN PETUALANGAN SERU DAN LUCU MEREKA. MELALUI BERMAIN DAN TAWA, PARA SAHABAT INI BELAJAR BEKERJA SAMA DAN MEMECAHKAN MASALAH DENGAN CARA YANG SANGAT MENGHIBUR.

programme.title: BABY ZU
programme.desc: Saksikan keseruan momo, cici, blu dan geng. menemani tumbuh kembangmu, generasi emas indonesia untuk dunia!

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: THE FIXIES
programme.desc: THE FIXIES ADALAH SERIAL ANIMASI RUSIA YANG MENGIKUTI PETUALANGAN PARA "FIXIES," MAKHLUK KECIL YANG HIDUP DI DALAM PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK. MEREKA MEMPERBAIKI MASALAH TEKNOLOGI SEHARI-HARI SAMBIL MENGAJARKAN PENONTON TENTANG SAINS DAN TEKNOLOGI SECARA MENYENANGKAN. SERIAL INI DIRANCANG UNTUK ANAK-ANAK UNTUK BELAJAR TENTANG PERANGKAT ELEKTRONIK DAN PENTINGNYA PERAWATANNYA.

programme.title: Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

Dibintangi oleh Rangga Azof, Mischa Chandrawinta, Dylan Car, Cut Syifa, Angela Gilsha, Ben Kasyafani, Haico Van der Veken, dan lain lainnya

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Cerita bermula di sebuah rumah sederhana. Rusdi bersama istrinya, Novi, dan ketiga anak mereka, Andra, Novan, dan Vina, sedang berbincang di ruang tamu sambil menonton televisi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.title: Istri Satu-Satunya
programme.desc: Istri Satu-Satunya adalah serial drama Indonesia tentang seorang wanita muda yang menyamar menjadi asisten rumah tangga (ART) di rumah suami ibunya untuk mengungkap rahasia masa lalu. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 16.00 WIB.

programme.title: Istri Satu-Satunya
programme.desc: Soraya menyamar sebagai asisten rumah tangga di rumah pria kaya dari masa lalunya yang bernama Pierre. Aksi ini ia lakukan demi membongkar rahasia kelam masa lalu keluarganya, dibantu oleh Mario di tengah konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Putri Pewaris
programme.desc: Sinetron Putri Pewaris mengisahkan Aina, perempuan sederhana yang ternyata pewaris sah perusahaan VOLTZ setelah masa lalu keluarganya terungkap. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 17.00 WIB

programme.title: Putri Pewaris
programme.desc: Aina, mahasiswi sekaligus SPG, tak sengaja berkonflik dengan Darel setelah mengunggah aksinya yang viral di media sosial. Tanpa mereka sadari, Darel adalah anak Ferdi, pria yang merebut perusahaan sekaligus membunuh ayah Aina 20 tahun lalu. Perseteruan Aina dan Darel semakin rumit setelah sebuah kejadian membuat mereka nyaris dinikahkan, hingga kebencian perlahan berubah menjadi cinta. Namun, akankah cinta mereka bertahan ketika rahasia kelam kedua keluarga mulai terungkap?

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Sinetron Cinta Seluas Samudra bercerita tentang pernikahan palsu yang terpaksa dijalani Andrian dengan asisten rumah tangganya, Maya, demi menyelamatkan nama baik keluarga pasca-kaburnya sang pengantin asli, perlahan menumbuhkan cinta tulus yang diuji oleh intrik balas dendam. Saksikan setiap hari pukul 18.25 WIB.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya terjebak dalam pernikahan palsu dengan Andrian, pewaris konglomerat yang perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, dendam Hana membawa Maya ke jurang dan membuatnya dinyatakan tewas. Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Rasa sakit dan cinta di ingatakanku akan terus kekal. Dan Sekarang, cinta itu kembali dengan wajah yang lain..? Wajah Cinta Yang lain dibintangi oleh Dinda Kirana, Ibrahim Risyad, Oka Antara, Aulia Sarah, Andi Anissa, dan Andri Mashadi.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: Sebuah pengkhianatan mengubah hidup Asti untuk selamanya. Kehilangan wajah, keluarga, dan kehidupan yang selama ini ia percaya, Asti bangkit dengan identitas baru untuk membongkar konspirasi yang menghancurkan hidupnya. Di balik setiap kebenaran yang terungkap, ia harus memilih antara membalas dendam atau memperjuangkan masa depan anak yang menjadi satu-satunya alasan ia bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara

programme.title: GBRB Spinoff: Cafeteria, Ep 4
programme.desc: Lee Kwang-soo dan Doh Kyung-soo kembali bersama untuk membuka kafetaria di dalam perusahaan produksi Eggiscoming. Hidangan seperti apa yang akan mereka siapkan menggunakan kentang yang baru dipanen dari sana?

programme.title: The First Ride
programme.desc: Empat sahabat seumur hidup—Tae Jeong, Do Jin, Yeon Min, dan Geum Bok—bermimpi melakukan perjalanan epik ke luar negeri, tetapi kehidupan menghalangi. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, lebih tua tetapi belum tentu lebih bijak, mereka akhirnya memulai perjalanan yang sudah lama tertunda.

programme.title: Samjin Company English Class
programme.desc: Pada pertengahan tahun 1990-an di Korea Selatan, tiga pegawai wanita yang mendaftar ke kelas Bahasa Inggris dengan harapan dapat memajukan karier mereka, berjuang untuk mengungkap korupsi di dalam perusahaan mereka.

programme.title: Steel Rain: Summit
programme.desc: Pertemuan perdamaian untuk Korea gagal saat pemimpin Korea Selatan, Korea Utara, dan Amerika Serikat diculik dan disandera di sebuah kapal selam oleh sekelompok ekstremis Korea Utara.

programme.title: The President's Barber
programme.desc: Sung Han-Mo, seorang tukang cukur yang tinggal di lingkungan kediaman Presiden Korea Selatan, Hyoja-dong. Dia dipercaya menjadi tukang cukur pribadi sang Presiden setelah dibodohi Cha Jhi Cul kepala keamanan presiden. Namun. menjadi seorang tukang cukur Presiden membuat hidupnya semakin runyam.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh yang kecewa menerima satu serangan terakhir dengan harapan dapat menggunakan penghasilannya untuk mengembalikan penglihatan seorang penyanyi yang secara tidak sengaja dibutakannya.

programme.title: The Moon
programme.desc: Seorang astronaut terdampar di luar angkasa karena sebuah kecelakaan saat melakukan penerbangan luar angkasa. Mantan direktur pusat antariksa pun berusaha keras untuk membawanya kembali ke bumi dengan selamat.

programme.title: The World Of Love
programme.desc: Jooin, seorang siswi berusia 17 tahun yang bingung dengan cinta, melepaskan kekacauan dengan beberapa kata yang diucapkan dalam momen kemarahan. Surat-surat anonim yang mempertanyakan tindakannya mulai berdatangan, mengubah kehidupan tenangnya.

programme.title: One Win (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Tentang seorang pelatih yang kurang sukses yang dipasangkan dengan tim bola voli putri yang selalu kalah dan hanya membutuhkan satu kemenangan agar pemiliknya dapat mempertahankan tim tersebut.

programme.title: The King (tvN Movies)

When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: After a comet disrupts the rain cycle of Earth, the planet has become a desolate, barren desert by the year 2033. With resources scarce, Kesslee (Malcolm McDowell) -- head of the powerful and evil Water & Power Corporation, the de facto government -- has taken control of the water supply. Unwilling to cower under Kesslee's tyrannical rule, a pair of outlaws known as Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and Jet Girl (Naomi Watts) rise up, joining the mysterious rebel Rippers to destroy the corrupt system.

programme.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
programme.desc: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.title: BloodRayne 2: Deliverance
programme.desc: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

programme.title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
programme.desc: Half-vampire, half-human Rayne must stop a Nazi official and his army of walking dead before they can carry out their plan to make Hitler immortal.

programme.title: Sharknado
programme.desc: A monstrous storm devastates Los Angeles, leaving the streets flooded and infested with sharks.

programme.title: Sharknado 2: The Second One
programme.desc: A freak weather system turns its deadly fury on New York City, unleashing a Sharknado on the population and its most cherished, iconic sites - and only Fin and April can save the Big Apple.

Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: D.O.A.: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Four beautiful rivals at an invitation-only martial-arts tournament join forces against a sinister threat. Princess Kasumi (Devon Aoki) is an aristocratic warrior trained by martial-arts masters. Tina Armstrong (Jaime Pressly) is a wrestling superstar. Helena Douglas (Sarah Carter) is an athlete with a tragic past. Christie Allen (Holly Valance) earns her keep as a thief and an assassin-for-hire.

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes).

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

programme.title: Solstice
programme.desc: While vacationing with friends, a teenager (Elisabeth Harnois) believes that her dead twin sister is trying to contact her.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

programme.title: Hair
programme.desc: In New York City for the first time while on his way to enlist in the U.S. Army during the Vietnam War, Oklahoma farm hand Claude Hooper Bukowski (John Savage) meets up with a freewheeling group of Central Park hippies led by the irrepressible George Berger (Treat Williams). When the unlikely friends meet upper-middle-class debutante Sheila Franklin (Beverly D'Angelo), sparks fly between the country boy and the city girl, and Berger's troupe attempts to keep the young lovers together.

programme.title: Wedding Daze
programme.desc: One year after accidentally scaring his fiancée to death, a young man (Jason Biggs) heeds his friend's advice and begins dating again. He hurriedly proposes to a waitress (Isla Fisher), but she has issues of her own, including a pair of problematic parents (Joe Pantoliano, Joanna Gleason).

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Masters of the Universe
programme.desc: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: D.O.A.: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Chasing the Dragon II: Wild Wild Bunch
programme.desc: The head of a notorious human trafficking gang begins abducting the children of Hong Kong's wealthy elite. Police forces send in an undercover agent to infiltrate the gang and save the hostages.

programme.title: Furie
programme.desc: A former gang leader battles human traffickers to save her kidnapped daughter.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration
programme.desc: While investigating a terrorist threat that goes online, Korean authorities discover that a suspect has recently boarded a flight bound for the United States. When a healthy passenger on the same plane suddenly dies, panic erupts both in-flight and on the ground. With steadily decreasing fuel and international refusals to offer aid, the captain and crew take unprecedented emergency measures to save the lives of all on board.

programme.title: Shadow
programme.desc: To finally achieve victory over a rival kingdom, a brilliant general devises an intricate plan involving his wife, a look-alike and two kings.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
programme.desc: Prim East Coast dandy Hiram Gummer (Michael Gross) arrives in the town of Rejection, Nev., to investigate a series of strange deaths at the silver mine he owns. He receives help from local innkeeper Christine Lord (Sara Botsford) and miner Juan Pedilla (Brent Roam). But, when it turns out that gigantic killer worms that burrow underground are responsible for the miners' deaths, Hiram decides he'd better call in expert gunslinger Black Hand Kelly (Billy Drago) to save the day.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: The Hunted
programme.desc: New York executive Paul Racine is on a business trip in Japan when he meets the stunning, enigmatic Kirina. They spend the night together in her hotel room, and Racine returns the next day to retrieve his forgotten keys. But once he's there, he witnesses Kirina's assassination by Kinjo, the leader of a ninja cult. Realizing that Racine has seen everything, Kinjo will do everything in his power to end the executive's life.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Crime boss Bart raises orphan Danny with no knowledge of anything other than how to fight, using him as an enforcer when debts must be collected. Planning to enter Danny into a fight tournament and retire with the prize money, Bart disappears after a deadly drive-by shooting. Danny flees and takes shelter with piano tuner Sam. Away from Bart's abusive control, Danny learns how to live like a human and begins investigating his past.

programme.title: Backdraft
programme.desc: Chicago firefighting brothers Stephen (Kurt Russell) and Brian (William Baldwin) have been rivals since childhood. Brian, struggling to prove himself, transfers to the arson unit. There he aids Don (Robert De Niro) in his investigation into a spate of fires involving oxygen-induced infernos called backdrafts. But when a conspiracy implicating a crooked politician and an arsonist leads Brian back to Stephen, he is forced to overcome his brotherly competitiveness in order to crack the case.

programme.title: Backdraft 2
programme.desc: A fire investigator with the Chicago Fire Department tracks an arms dealer who uses deadly fires as a distraction.

programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: A group of armed robbers fleeing the police head for the New Jersey Tunnel and run right into trucks transporting toxic waste. The spectacular explosion that follows results in both ends of the tunnel collapsing and the handful of people who survived the explosion are now in peril. Kit Latura is the only man with the skill and knowledge to lead the band of survivors out of the tunnel before the structure collapses.

programme.title: Street Fighter
programme.desc: Gen. Bison (Raul Julia), the evil dictator of Shadaloo, captures a busload of relief workers and holds them for ransom. Col. Guile (Jean-Claude Van Damme) leads an international strike force to invade Shadaloo and rescue the hostages. Along the way, Guile recruits Chun-Li (Ming-Na Wen), a reporter and martial-arts expert whose father was killed by Bison years ago, two young con men (Damian Chapa, Byron Mann) and a sumo wrestler (Peter Navy Tuiasosopo).

programme.title: Serenity
programme.desc: In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 2: Rise of a Warrior
programme.desc: After a swarm of enchanted scorpions kills his father, Mathayus (Michael Copon) flees and vows to even the score with ruthless sorcerer Sargon (Randy Couture). Upon returning home after years of combat training, Mathayus finds that Sargon has seized the crown and protected himself with a powerful spell. To retrieve the only weapon capable of destroying the tyrant -- a mystical sword -- Mathayus and lady warrior Layla (Karen David) set off for a labyrinth guarded by a deadly Minotaur.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: In this action-comedy, unusual circumstances find big, brawny cop John Kimble (Arnold Schwarzenegger) posing as a kindergarten teacher in order to apprehend major drug lord Cullen Crisp (Richard Tyson), as well as his ruthless accomplice and mother, Eleanor (Carroll Baker). While pretending to be a kid-friendly instructor, Kimble falls for pretty fellow teacher Joyce Palmieri (Penelope Ann Miller) as he battles both unruly children and dangerous bad guys.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: Thunderbirds
programme.desc: Former astronaut Jeff Tracy (Bill Paxton) runs International Rescue, a top-secret heroic organization, from his headquarters on Tracy Island. The island also houses the futuristic vehicles created by Ray "Brains" Hackenbacker (Anthony Edwards). But while Jeff is on a mission in space, his nemesis, The Hood (Ben Kingsley), invades Tracy Island. The Hood plots to use the island's technology for evil, and only Jeff's son, Alan (Brady Corbet), can stop him.

programme.title: Undercover Brother
programme.desc: Blasted from the past and ready to take care of business, "Undercover Brother" is recruited to infiltrate a sinister underground movement headed by The Man. Partnered with the sassy, stunning Sistah Girl, our hero must first undergo the ultimate attitude adjustment and trade in his 'fro and platforms for tennis sweaters and penny loafers. Once the transformation is complete, he's ready to take on the evil perpetrators of Operation Whitewash.

programme.title: Alpha Dog
programme.desc: Teenage dealer Johnny Truelove (Emile Hirsch) and his friends kidnap the impressionable younger brother (Anton Yelchin) of a junkie (Ben Foster) who refuses to pay his drug debt. Things change unexpectedly when Frankie (Justin Timberlake), one of Johnny's pals, befriends the youth.

programme.title: Slither

No one notices when evil slips in quietly but when people find mutilated livestock and a woman goes missing, Sheriff Bill Pardy discovers an alien organism that threatens to devour all life on Earth.

The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: On Dec. 7, 1941, Japanese forces launch a devastating attack on Pearl Harbor, the U.S. naval base in Hawaii. Six months later, the Battle of Midway commences on June 4, 1942, as the Japanese navy once again plans a strike against American ships in the Pacific. For the next three days, the U.S. Navy and a squad of brave fighter pilots engage the enemy in one of the most important and decisive battles of World War II.

programme.title: Emperor
programme.desc: Following the Japanese surrender at the end of World War II, Gen. Bonner Fellers must determine whether Emperor Hirohito should be hanged as a war criminal.

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Staff Sgt. William James (Jeremy Renner), Sgt. J.T. Sanborn (Anthony Mackie) and Specialist Owen Eldridge (Brian Geraghty) are members of a bomb-disposal unit in Baghdad. As their tour of duty enters its final weeks, the men face a set of increasingly hazardous situations, any of which could end their lives in an explosive instant.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: On April 20, 2010, the Deepwater Horizon drilling rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico, igniting a massive fireball that kills several crew members. Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island -- only to find that surviving the landing was just the beginning. When dangerous rebels take most of the passengers hostage, the only person Torrance can count on for help is Louis Gaspare, an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Continue
programme.desc: Convinced she's fated to walk the same troubled path as her father, Dean suffers a major mental health episode and is committed to a rehabilitation facility. Once confined, Dean shudders through the agonies of recovery, and bravely comes out the other side armed with a defense against the darkness, summed up in one word: Continue.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Splinter No More

programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: The Knights Code
programme.desc: Jestro uses the Book of Chaos to unleash, um, chaos and attack the King's hover train to try and kidnap the royal party. Can the NEXO-Knights bring order out of the chaos and save the King? Jestro finds the Book of Chaos in the countryside and decides he must feed it to the book. The Book of Monsters actually tells Jestro NOT to feed it to him he tells Jestro he's not ready for that kind of power. But Jestro doesn't listen. Now the Book unleashes chaotic monsters and Jestro uses them to attack the King and his party who are on a business-related tour of the kingdom. When the NEXO-Knights show up to stop the monster attacks and realize that they must save King and Queen Halbert – Macy's parents – from the chaotic evil monsters that have been unleashed. Clay asserts himself as leader and brings order to the knights from the chaos. He has his own book: the Book of the Knight's Code. They should all live by it.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs

Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!
